description_en: Retrieves the version information of an edge container application. You can use the version information to select a specific version for publishing
description_zh: 获取边缘容器应用的版本信息，通过版本信息选择某个版本进行发布
kebab_example: aliyun esa get-edge-container-app-version --app-id app-880688675783790000 --version-id ver-879626371616510000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetEdgeContainerAppVersion

parameters.description_en: The application ID. You can call the [ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~) operation to obtain the application ID.
parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can call the [ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~) operation to obtain the application ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description_en: The version ID. You can call the [ListEdgeContainerAppVersions](~~ListEdgeContainerAppVersions~~) operation to obtain the version ID.
parameters.help_en: The version ID. You can call the [ListEdgeContainerAppVersions](~~ListEdgeContainerAppVersions~~) operation to obtain the version ID
parameters.name: version_id
